messages.text: The K. is off sale right now — the manufacturer deal lapsed, so it's not buyable. Closest thing I'd actually put in front of you is the Magic Miner 40T at $799, the best value per TH we sell. Want me to run the sats and power cost on it at your rate?

context.pop: What do you pay for power? I'll run the GekkoScience KBeast numbers for where you live.
